title: 推荐 Ramp 自建 Agent harness（Laminar）的思路：模型与
html:
推荐 Ramp 自建 Agent harness（Laminar）的思路：模型与

Build your own harness, folks!

Highly recommended reading on Ramp's own agent harness and why they built one.

I've seen this closely. More hardcore engineering teams are realizing how important it is to own the harness. I expect more full-stack AI companies to follow.

Ramp quickly realized they could move faster and better with their agent harness.

Benefits:

- Model-and-provider agnostic

- Shipping faster as the harness is closer to other teams

- Owning the observability stack (a must given the complexity of agentic systems today)

Their Laminar harness supports secure conversation storage, MCP for standard tool calling, durable execution, code execution sandboxes, observability tools, and more.

When you own the harness, you can co-evolve it to meet your needs. The foundations don't change much; only the tooling and behavior need extending, so make the harness malleable from the start.

Ramp also made several interesting design choices, such as using sandbox-as-a-tool, leveraging Boring and a standard stack (Postgres, S3, etc.), always-open agent sessions, and going all-in on cloud.

html_zh:
推荐 Ramp 自建 Agent harness（Laminar）的思路：模型与

各位，打造自己的安全带！

强烈推荐阅读有关 Ramp 自己的特工装备以及他们为何建造这一装备的文章。

我已经仔细地看到了这一点。越来越多的核心工程团队正在意识到拥有该安全带是多么重要。我预计会有更多全栈人工智能公司跟进。

Ramp 很快意识到，借助特工安全带，他们可以更快更好地行动。

好处：

- 模型和提供商不可知

- 由于安全带距离其他团队更近，运输速度更快

- 拥有可观察性堆栈（考虑到当今代理系统的复杂性，这是必须的）

他们的 Laminar 工具支持安全对话存储、用于标准工具调用的 MCP、持久执行、代码执行沙箱、可观察性工具等。

当您拥有该安全带后，您可以对其进行共同进化以满足您的需求。基础没有太大变化；只有工具和行为需要扩展，因此从一开始就使线束具有可塑性。

Ramp 还做出了一些有趣的设计选择，例如使用沙箱作为工具、利用 Boring 和标准堆栈（Postgres、S3 等）、始终开放的代理会话以及全力投入云。
